positive.prompt: Collapse these duplicate modules and dead wrappers while keeping all behavior identical.
Fold the copy-pasted modules together and remove unreachable paths while keeping outputs identical.
Remove shallow indirection as a behavior-preserving cleanup and open one final PR.

negative.prompt: Hunt for correctness defects and write a failing regression test for every repair.
Use the benchmark harness to prove this hot path is faster than measurement noise.

evals.prompt: Simplify a forwarding module. Describe the dispatch sequence and mechanical test gate.
evals.expected_output: A baseline-sealed refactor transcript with no test-author dispatch.
expectations: No test-author is dispatched and no test file is changed.
An integrator proves the existing suite green and creates a kind: baseline seal before the builder runs in refactor mode.
The builder uses the ordinary post-seal green verification and diff-review state machine.
